claim: Treatment FX-42 increased concentrations of marker Z in cultured cells.

abstract: Cultured cells were randomly assigned to FX-42 treatment or a control group.
Marker Z concentrations were higher after FX-42 treatment than in the control group.
documents.title: A fictional marker experiment
